Start2.title: Story
Start2.text:
You were born and raised in a settlement built around a conquered ant hill. The settlement is bustling with hunters and craftsmen who devote their lives on feeding and protecting the community.

You, lacking the courage to hunt and lacking the skills to craft, have become a scout.

Start3.title: Story
Start3.text:
Every day, you wake up early in the morning and patrol the nearby area to notify the settlement of any dangers or things to scavenge.

This is a dangerous job. Many scouts disappear without a trace every week. Like any scout, you must carry a weapon around at all times, even if you don't have the courage to fight. Your weapon of choice was...

Startrange.title: Story
Startrange.text:
You carry around a ranged weapon in case there is something weak that you can hunt from outside danger's reach.

Your ranged weapon of choice was...

Startmelee.title: Story
Startmelee.text:
You carry around a melee weapon to prepare for the worst case scenario of being ambushed by one of the many dangerous predators near the hill.

Your melee weapon of choice was...

To Ant Hill.title: Ant Hill
To Ant Hill.text:
%timeYou walk for about 15 minutes.
You finally reach the end of the forest of grass to an open view of the outskirts of Ant Hill. The outskirts pretty desolate and are littered with chitin, furs, and pieces of leaves.

You see the main hill and the market street in the distance.

Ant Hill1.title: Ant Hill
Ant Hill1.text: You are at Ant Hill. Hunters are setting up their shops along the streets leading to the hill.%time

Ant Hill2.title: Ant Hill
Ant Hill2.text: You are at Ant Hill. The streets are filled with people walking around trying to buy from the hunters selling their meat on display.%time

Ant Hill3.title: Ant Hill
Ant Hill3.text: You are at Ant Hill.%timeIt is dark, and there are no human presence on the streets.
